title: Xsearch: Exploring Microarchitecture Design Space Through Bayesian Optimization and Cross Evaluation on Multi-Fidelity Simulators
extraction_scope: Official description and bounded source search; no full paper, numerical evaluation or artifact recovered

attempts.outcome: Official presentation and poster descriptions recovered. No exact full paper or artifact. BigPower appeared as a different-title work with overlapping authors; not admitted as XSearch evidence.

description_conditions.method: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization cross-evaluating designs and calibrating with higher-fidelity simulation data
description_conditions.limit: The source names the method and application but not quantitative superiority.

coding_clarification.decision: Preserve original coding for provenance, but do not cite these labels as evaluated baselines.

unresolved_conditions: Simulator identities, versions, calibration target and measured error
XiangShan revision, legal parameter ranges and design-space size
Workload suite, warmup and simulation sampling protocol
Acquisition function, fidelity selection and cross-evaluation rule
Initial sample cost, training cost and total wall-clock budget
Held-out validation, repeated seeds and convergence
Matched-budget baseline results and final high-fidelity evaluation
interpretation_limits: High-fidelity simulator output is not necessarily silicon ground truth.
More design points explored is not sufficient evidence of better feasible designs.
Application to an open-source core does not establish release of the search implementation.
No numerical result reported is not a zero improvement.
Related-author papers cannot supply missing XSearch experimental conditions.
revisit_condition: Verified exact manuscript or implementation exposing simulator settings, budgets and held-out final-design results.
